NewsArticle.Title: Politics: Admit Citizen
NewsArticle.Content:
Aingeal, in Mileth Tavern, and Angelo, in Rucesion Storage offer politics for their respective village. In this way, a new citizen may be admitted.
Mundanes heard of the difficulty in which a new citizen had in being admitted recently; these two lease their souls to politics.
